title: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story Anime Reveals 1st Trailer, More Cast & Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Aito Aoyagi 's Akazukin, Tabi no Tochū de Shitai to Deau ( Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story , or literally Little Red Riding Hood Encounters a Dead Body During Her Journey.) novel revealed on Monday the anime's first trailer, first key visual, additional cast and staff members,…
author: ANN

title: The Record of a Fallen Vampire Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Monday to announce the television anime adaptation of Kyo Shirodaira and Yuri Kimura 's The Record of a Fallen Vampire ( Vampire Jūjikai ) manga, which will debut in 2027. The website also revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, teaser visual, and main cast and staff members.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Vampire Juujikai' Gets TV Anime For 2027
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyou Shirodaira 's Vampire Juujikai ( The Record of a Fallen Vampire ) on Monday revealing the main cast pair, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promo. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Psikyo Memories Collection Reveals Full List of Games, February 18 Release
content: Edia opened the official website for its Psikyo Memories , a collection of '90s arcade scrolling shooter games by Psikyo, on Monday. The company also revealed the full list of games included in the collection, and its February 18, 2027 release for Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5.
author: ANN

title: Macross 7, Synduality: Noir Animator Kenichirō Katsura Dies at 59
content: Animator Satoko Miyachi announced on her X (formerly Twitter ) account on Monday that her husband, animator Kenichirō Katsura , died on September 30, while undergoing medical treatment for an illness. He was 59. A private funeral was held with only close relatives in attendance.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Hirayasumi' Ends in Two Chapters
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for author Keigo Shinzou announced on Monday that the Hirayasumi manga will end in two more chapters. Shinzou began drawing the manga in Big Comic Spirits in April 2021. Shogakukan published the tenth volume on April 30.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Mikito Chinen's Horror Novel Gets Manga Adaptation
content: Hiromoto Komatsu launched a manga adaptation of Mikito Chinen 's Etsuran Genkin Ryōki Satsujin-han no Seishin Kantei Hōkoku-sho (Restricted Reading: Psychiatric Evaluation Report of a Bizarre Murderer) horror novel on Futabasha 's Web Comic Action platform on September 25.
author: ANN

title: Yuki Kure's Ayame-san Chi no Geshuku-nin Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The November issue of Hakusensha 's LaLa DX magazine revealed on Monday that Yuki Kure 's Ayame-san Chi no Geshuku-nin ( Ayame's House Lodger ) manga will end with its next chapter in the magazine's next issue on December 4 (the magazine publishes a new issue every two months).
author: ANN

title: Chanta Launches Noro-Noro Puku-Puku Manga
content: Manga creator Chanta launched a new manga titled Noro-Noro Puku-Puku in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ manga service on Monday. The manga is available in English on Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service. MANGA Plus describes the manga: An exceptionally cursed shrine maiden, Suzu, incurs the divine punishment of the gods one day...
author: ANN

title: Naoki Shigeno to End Sanada Damashii Manga in 6th Volume
content: Hakusensha is listing the sixth volume of Naoki Shigeno 's Sanada Damashii manga series as the final volume. The volume will ship on November 27. The series is a four-panel comic depicting the activities of the Sanada clan in the Sengoku period.
author: ANN
